summary: Quetta Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing a $5,000 extension payment deposited into its trust account for public stockholders on October 10, 2026. The payment extends the blank-check company's deadline to consummate an initial business combination by one month, from October 10, 2026 to November 10, 2026. The filing names no target, deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor. The structural overhang is a one-month regulatory clock, with repeated monthly extensions likely if no combination is reached; watch for a definitive agreement or further extension deposits, with trust liquidation risk if the November deadline passes.
